newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in two shipments at a tender on Tuesday, traders said.
Freight for the first shipment was fixed at US$22.15 per tonne and the second at US$20.50 per tonne, traders said.

The shipments contain dark northern spring (DNS), hard red winter (HRW) and white wheat (WW), sprint wheat (SW) and durum wheat and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.
The association placed the tender on behalf of several major Taiwan wheat buying firms, including Tai Yu Products, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed and Lien Hwa Industry and other wheat millers.
